responsibility: Provides rustc’s trait-system execution layer: it assembles the crate’s trait APIs and query providers; solves, evaluates, and fulfills trait and projection obligations through both the old selection/projection/fulfillment engine and the Chalk/new-solver-backed engine; supports codegen-time selection, coherence and specialization overlap analysis, object safety, well-formedness, implied outlives, dropck and const-evaluatability checks, structural-match and builtin-marker validation, and auto-trait synthesis; exposes canonical trait queries and NLL/MIR type operations for normalization, equality, subtyping, predicate proving, user-type ascription, implied outlives, and dropck; tracks inference relationships and shared utilities; and integrates the full trait diagnostic stack, including ambiguity analysis, `#[rustc_on_unimplemented]` notes, and fix suggestions.
